The '''Armahn''' is a river flowing through the north of [[Murandy]]. It springs from the hills north of the [[Andor]]an border and converges with the [[Reisendrelle]] north of [[Lugard]].

A group of [[Andoran]] and [[Murandian]] nobles camp near the River Armahn. They intended to stop [[Egwene al'Vere]] and the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] from marching through Andor and Murandy.{{ref/book|8|15}} Possibly connected with the minor Andoran House, [[House Armaghn|Armaghn]].

== Parallels ==
The name is similar to the county and town of [[wikipedia:Armagh|Armagh]] in present-day Northern Ireland that has historical importance. [[Gareth Bryne]] mentions peat bogs in the area, another connection with Ireland.
